events.content:
Done. The `UserProfile` component is implemented and the build passes.

The codebase already had a stub at `app/UserProfile.tsx` with a TODO describing this exact task, so I filled it in rather than creating a new file. Following the pattern from `page.tsx`, it's an async server component with a `getUser()` helper that fetches `/api/users/profile` and falls back to mock data in a `catch` (so the build doesn't fail when the API isn't reachable, same as `getProducts`). It renders the user's name and email under a "User Profile" heading, and it was already imported and rendered on the dashboard page, so no wiring changes were needed.

Verification: `tsc --noEmit` is clean and `next build` succeeds (Next.js also auto-added an `include` entry to `tsconfig.json` during the build — that's its own doing, left as is). One note: like the existing `/api/products` fetch, `/api/users/profile` has no route handler in this repo yet, so at runtime it will hit the mock fallback until that API exists.
